claims: Collin Morikawa withdrew from The Players Championship in March 2026 due to a sudden back injury.
The back injury was specifically described as a back spasm felt during a practice swing on the 11th tee during the first round.
Collin Morikawa described the injury as a recurring, severe issue that made it impossible to swing through, forcing his withdrawal.
The injury was a back injury/spasms triggered during a practice swing on the 11th tee at TPC Sawgrass.
Collin Morikawa withdrew from the Valero Texas Open to recover.
Collin Morikawa returned for the 2026 Masters.
Collin Morikawa stated he was "taking it day by day".
Collin Morikawa stated that the injury did not worsen.
Collin Morikawa stated that he had to manage residual effects and mental hurdles.
Collin Morikawa indicated he underwent MRIs.
Collin Morikawa indicated he focused on rest and rehab to ensure the injury did not create further, long-term setbacks.
